name: Valencia County, NM

peers.name: St. John the Baptist Parish, LA

findings: Valencia County has 129 nonprofit organizations. 56 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 47 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Valencia County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
38% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Valencia County list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 74% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 30 organizations here; 50% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 11 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 50% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
